description: This Java interface defines configuration settings related to credit decisions in persistence cleanup actions, providing methods to retrieve timing intervals, timeouts, database thresholds, and credit batch sizes, as well as an enumeration of default configuration values.

classes.name: ConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration key-value pairs with default values for credit decision settings.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval between successive credit decisions.

methods.name: getMetricReportTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum wait time for metric reports before failing.

methods.name: getTimerThreshold
methods.description: Returns the maximum database latency considered acceptable for giving out credit.

methods.name: getCreditPerBatch
methods.description: Returns the amount of credit given per decision.
